functional_interpretation.queue: At C1 simultaneous peers can be admitted in opposite orders. Main itself alternates first/second admission in the two sampling-default cohorts. The candidate's affected per-request prefill/decode work is equal or faster. Wall/TTFT/queue flags remain visible; different admission histories are not an equal-history latency comparison.
functional_interpretation.mtp_image_snapshot: Initial 81.798->86.293 ms; cache-only 83.838->88.973 ms. Unchanged-main control reaches 87.396 ms with identical copy bytes. Overlapping control variation; retained as inconclusive, not a timing pass.
functional_interpretation.ar_cache_resume: The final cache-only candidate repeat passes all 737 phase measurements. One-token legacy-tool decode is 51.288->54.060 ms; the preceding candidate outlier was 73.795 ms against 51.306 ms. Thinking/tool continuation returns to 245.849 ms against 246.021 ms. Combined independent pairs retain eight inconclusive metrics and zero confirmed failures; outliers are not discarded.

comparison_invocation_errors.ready-cache-controlled-off-final-compari: reused observations cannot confirm a regression

functional_interpretation.comparison_error_resolution: One attempted combined comparison reused the same main run as both a paired observation and a control, which the harness correctly rejected. The corrected off-pairs comparison uses the two independent pairs without duplicating evidence.

pi.sampling: All 17 actual request bodies omit sampling controls; server defaults apply.
pi.inspection: Inspected the session and files: read/edit/bash fix subtraction to addition; Node regression tests fail before the slugify fix and pass afterwards, twice. Those two expected failing test results are not protocol failures.

translation_followup.qualification: Non-default sampled translation repeats about 9% slower with different text and acceptance. Both translations preserve the requested meaning; the candidate's extra grammar explanation incorrectly labels the declension. This is not an equal-output speed comparison or evidence of equivalent individual-answer quality. Full target logits and probability-correction tests pass; no statistical language quality claim is made from this single seed.

limits: Regression evidence against main, not original unquantized-model/conversion accuracy.
Changed proposals may consume random numbers differently across builds.
No claim that every sampled answer or request becomes faster.
Pi smoke covers four actual coding tasks; it is not the original author's long agent replay.
Published BENCHMARKS.md, root README numbers, graphs and llama.cpp data are unchanged.
